comment: I definitely don't want AI forced on me in Buckets. If it's there as an option, which I can ignore, that's fine, but if it becomes something I can't opt out of, I'd have to leave Buckets. And I'd hate that because it's been amazing for me. I'd personally rather see less AI use in general in software, but how you create it is up to you. Just please don't make AI features mandatory.
name: H
